definition: an expert on money, prices and trade
description: At a busy street market on a wet cobbled square, a young woman with long braids and a camel coat crouches beside crates of onions and potatoes and writes on a clipboard with a small line graph drawn on it. She looks up thoughtfully, taps her pen against her chin and goes on writing. A chalkboard next to her shows the prices of potatoes and onions per kilo. Above her an older trader in a flat cap and apron holds out an onion, and a hanging scale and customers fill the back under striped awnings.

taps.target: the woman in the dark jacket
